sources.title: 胜严寺Thắng Nghiêm II 2013年民间术数藏书群79件的机构移交及语言说明
sources.provider: Vietnamese Nôm Preservation Foundation (VNPF) / Thắng Nghiêm collection
sources.quality_notes: VNPF states October 2013 transfer of 79 items from deceased medium's family to temple. Custody context only, not item work production date, teaching lineage or every item's usage.

sources.title: 胜严寺TN208 / TNVNPF-110《安星紫㣲錦宅》57页未断年汉文手抄本
sources.provider: Vietnamese Nôm Preservation Foundation (VNPF) / Thắng Nghiêm collection
sources.quality_notes: Catalog gives anon, 57 pages, 27x14cm, handwritten Han, no composition/copy date, 2013 imaging and birth input/family palace catalog summary. Viewer counts 57 pages; no original detailed glyph or algorithm collation.

sources.title: 胜严寺TN213 / TNVNPF-115《蘿𢼂紫㣲个人》命盘记录及90／61页界限
sources.provider: Vietnamese Nôm Preservation Foundation (VNPF) / Thắng Nghiêm collection
sources.quality_notes: Catalog metadata says 90 pages and Woodblock text while viewer Page 1 of 61; descriptions mention hand-drawn charts and dated birth records. Neither page equality nor printing process decided, no private names reprinted, and no direct mechanical link to TN208.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: TN208 and TN213 are same holding group, not same textual tradition or proven operational manuscript relationship.
Page count 90 metadata vs 61 viewer for TN213 remains unadjudicated.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Dated original leaf and mechanical chart rules for TN208/TN213
TN213 page count and catalog woodblock text vs handdrawn charts material
